_about: The authors' own comparison of each formal statement of the literature file with the published theorem its name refers to. Made from the Lean statement, read by the author, and from the author's knowledge of the published theorem; the papers were not opened for this purpose. scope: general (the published theorem in the generality of a cited source), restricted (a special case or a weaker form), differs (not a statement of the cited literature as it stands), internal, empty, conclusion.
LogDerOne: the value at $s=1$ of the classical formula for $L'/L$ in terms of nearby zeros
EllipticMainTheoremCM: imaginary quadratic fields and lattices that are fractional ideals of the maximal order; Shimura's theorem covers any lattice and CM abelian varieties
HeckeTateFunctionalEquation: totally complex fields and infinity types coming from a CM type; the published theorem covers every Hecke character of every number field
HilbertClassFieldJ: the first main theorem of complex multiplication for the maximal order
PartialZetaFunctionalEquation: totally real fields; Hecke's functional equation holds for every number field
DeligneRibet: conductor a power of $\ell$ and rational values; the published theorem allows any conductor and $\ell$-adic values
SiegelKlingenDeligneRibet: a conjunction whose second part is the restricted statement above
JoinOut: a bundle of five statements in the archive's own terms
HtCard: stated for the host fields of the archive's data; the fact holds for every de Rham representation
AbMulNSt: the classical count of torsion points
AbelianDeRham: five standard facts, over an arbitrary affine base
DeRhamPotSemistable: the $p$-adic monodromy theorem for finite extensions of $\Q_\ell$
GlobalArtinReciprocity: the idelic Artin map: an open quotient map with the classical kernel, compatible with inertia, Frobenius and decomposition groups
HeckeLAdicCharacterDeRham: every algebraic Hecke character of every number field
AlgebraicCharacterWD: every finite place, those above $\ell$ included
ArCalc: seven standard properties of arithmetic intersection numbers; the normalisations were not compared with the papers
ArDegree: birational invariance of arithmetic self-intersection and the Chern--Weil formula for the degree, two standard facts
Principalisation: smooth projective varieties; Hironaka's theorem needs no projectivity
ArithHilbertSamuel: the nef form, which is Moriwaki's
AutomorphicFormsFiniteGL: $\GL_a$ over totally complex fields; Harish-Chandra's theorem covers reductive groups over any number field
BaseChangeIsobaricTransfer: weak base change from a definite unitary group, under hypotheses of the kind Labesse makes
BaseChangeDefiniteUnitaryGroup: the same with irreducible local components
BernsteinUnitaryProductIrreducible: Bernstein's theorem, which is about general linear groups
BhattScholzeIntegral: the theorem of Bhatt and Scholze on lattices in crystalline representations
BlochKatoLocal: the local results of Bloch and Kato for a finite extension of $\Q_\ell$
BorelCasselman: $\GL_n$; the theorem of Borel and Casselman is for reductive groups
BrauerDegreeZero: the degree-zero form of Brauer's induction theorem
EssSquareIntegrableSegments: characteristic $0$; the theorem holds for every non-archimedean local field
LocalConverseGL: cuspidal representations in characteristic $0$; Henniart's theorem is for generic representations in any characteristic
RecTExists: existence of a map with a list of consequences of the local Langlands correspondence, not the correspondence itself
PairUAlt: the Galois representation exists, with compatibility away from $\ell$ only in part: equal dimension, equality when the local parameter is a sum of characters with trivial monodromy, and agreement on inertia for a class of tame parameters
JacquetShalikaRigidity: totally complex fields; the theorem of Jacquet and Shalika is for any number field
GelfandKazhdanDual: a global consequence, for cuspidal representations, of the local theorem of Gelfand and Kazhdan
GeometricLemma: the geometric lemma for $\GL_n$, as in Zelevinsky
DepthZeroInduction: $\GL_n$ in characteristic $0$ and depth zero; the theorem of Moy and Prasad is for reductive groups and every depth
IrreducibleAdmissibleGL: admissibility of irreducible smooth representations of $\GL_n$
CasselmanWallach: real unitary groups and unitary representations; the theorem is for real reductive groups and admissible modules
ChebotarevDegreeOne: an existence statement that follows from the density theorem
ClozelCohomological: totally complex fields; Clozel's lemma is for any number field
ComplexMultiplicationJSt: the main theorem of complex multiplication for $j$-invariants of ideal lattices
CuspBounded: unitary groups of Hermitian spaces over CM fields
CuspDecayBound: the same groups, in a quantitative form
CuspDecaySobolev: a Sobolev-norm form of rapid decay, not the statement of rapid decay in the standard references
CuspRapidDecay: unitary groups of Hermitian spaces over CM fields
CycleHeights: existence and standard properties of arithmetic heights; the normalisations were not compared with the papers
DepthZeroJacquetInjective: $\GL_n$ at depth zero, and only injectivity
DiscreteSeriesClassification: the groups $\U(p,q)$, with a weaker statement on $K$-types than Schmid's
DixmierMalliavinFactorisation: closed linear groups; the theorem is for all Lie groups
SiegelEisensteinContinuation: Siegel Eisenstein series on doubled unitary groups; Langlands's theorem is for all Eisenstein series
DoublingMethodLocalZetaIntegrals: the global identity of the doubling method with the continuation above; nothing about local zeta integrals, despite the name
FlathTensorProduct: unitary groups of Hermitian spaces over CM extensions
UnitaryIrreducibleAdmissible: these unitary groups; Bernstein's theorem is for reductive groups
GLHoweDuality: the duality of $\GL_n$ and $\GL_{n'}$ on polynomials
CuspUAlt: the Galois representation exists, with compatibility away from $\ell$ only in part: equal dimension, equality when the local parameter is a sum of characters with trivial monodromy, and agreement on inertia for a class of tame parameters; the literature gives full compatibility
GeometricLemmaFiltration: the filtration half of the geometric lemma
GoodChernWeil: Mumford's theorem for good metrics and the push-forward formula for flag bundles, in the archive's coordinates
GreenCuspidal: prime fields; Green's theorem is for every finite field
AbelianLifting: the lifting half of the theory of Grothendieck and Messing
GrothendieckDeformation: the theory of Grothendieck and Messing for abelian schemes
GrothendieckMessing: the same when a prime is nilpotent
principalPolarisationOneSection: a classical consequence of Riemann--Roch on abelian varieties
HarishChandraAnalyticity: the groups $\U(p,q)$ and their Levi subgroups
HarishChandraFinite: unitary groups of Hermitian spaces over CM extensions
HarishChandraModules: the groups $\U(p,q)$ and their double covers
HasseNormSt: quadratic extensions; the norm theorem is for cyclic extensions
HeckeLAdicCharacter: every number field and every algebraic Hecke character
HeckeLAdicCharacterCrystalline: every place above $\ell$ at which the character is unramified
HeckeLAdicCharacterAbove: the properties at the places above $\ell$
HeckeLAdicParameterAboveAlt: compatibility at the places above $\ell$ for $\GL_1$
HeckeLEntireAndNonzeroAtOne: every unitary Hecke character of every number field
HeckeLPartialContinuation: the same with finitely many Euler factors removed
HermitianLocalGlobal: the local classification and Landherr's global theorem
HoweDualityReal: unitary dual pairs, and only the lift of the trivial representation
IdealInvariantsOneOrbitSt: the classical statement on the conjugates of $j$
InducedSimpleLowestAlcove: $\GL_N$; the statement holds for reductive groups
KawamataViehweg: the vanishing theorem for nef and big line bundles
KudlaSplittingSplitUnitary: the split member $\mathrm{U}(\nu,\nu)$ of the pair only; Kudla's splitting covers both members of a unitary dual pair; stated in characteristic $0$
L2ExtensionLogCanonical: extension from a finite set of points; the theorems of Ohsawa--Takegoshi type cover subvarieties
LandherrSt: Landherr's classification over a CM field
CarUAlt: as \lean{CuspUAlt}: compatibility away from $\ell$ only in part
MetaplecticRepresentation: the oscillator representation of the metaplectic group
NadelVanishingAndNonKltDivisor: vanishing for some ideal with the right support, which is weaker than Nadel's theorem for the multiplier ideal
NefNumerics: three standard facts on nef line bundles
PointSeparationPair: the criterion of Angehrn and Siu in Koll\'ar's numerical form, with his constants
PoitouTateNormalised: $\ell$-power torsion modules, with $\ell\ne2$ or the field totally complex
PrismaticDieudonneHodge: over the ring of integers of a complete algebraically closed field; the theory is over quasi-syntomic rings
QuadraticClassFieldTheory: class field theory for quadratic extensions, which is what the name says
HeckeCharacterZeroLocus.SiegelWeilU.Sieg: finite volume, and the formula in Weil's range as a mass formula for representation densities
RallisInnerProductConvergent: the convergent range, for unitary pairs
RayCharacterArtin: Artin reciprocity for ray class characters
RegularAlgebraicPurity: CM fields; Clozel's lemmas are for any number field
SemiAbelianHomExtension: extension of homomorphisms over a normal base
SemistableReductionSt: $p$-adic fields and polarised abelian varieties; Grothendieck's theorem is for any discretely valued field
SerreHolomorphicSections: global sections of line bundles on smooth projective varieties; Serre's theorem covers coherent sheaves and all cohomology
SiegelSetUnitary: unitary groups of Hermitian forms over CM extensions
SiegelWeilUnitarySchrodinger: the same formula in another model
StoneVonNeumann: the theorem for the Heisenberg group of a non-archimedean local field
StrongApproxSU: special unitary groups; the theorem is for simply connected groups
ThetaRationalInvariance: a statement in the archive's own terms
ToroidalCompactification: unitary moduli problems of PEL type in characteristic $0$
TotallyDisjointProductIrreducible: an irreducibility criterion in the theory of Bernstein and Zelevinsky
UnlinkedProductIrreducible: a hypothesis much stronger than Zelevinsky's unlinked segments
UnramifiedDoublingGL: the unramified computation of the doubling integral for $\GL_n$; stated in characteristic $0$
VolGe: the lower bound for the arithmetic volume of a nef Hermitian line bundle
WeberRayFieldSt: ray class fields of imaginary quadratic fields by values of the Weber function
WeilRepresentationExists: existence of the Weil representation of a unitary dual pair
DualAbelianScheme: existence of the dual abelian scheme
ZarhinStatement: over the valuation ring of an algebraically closed non-archimedean field
FarguesExact: the statement of Fargues on the kernel of the Hodge--Tate map
NefRR: the asymptotic Riemann--Roch statement of \lean{NefNumerics}, on the generic fibre of an arithmetic variety
PoincareLelongInv: a form of the Poincar\'e--Lelong formula used for heights; its exact shape was not compared with a published formula
PrincipalisationCharZero: principalisation compatible with a divisor with simple normal crossings
Cheb: an existence statement that follows from the density theorem
EisBL: Siegel Eisenstein series on doubled unitary groups
SiegelWeilStd: the Siegel--Weil formula for a definite space
LocalMatching: a statement in the archive's own terms
GlobalFiniteness: finiteness of Galois cohomology with restricted ramification
GreenbergWiles: the formula of Greenberg and Wiles
LocalEulerCharK: Tate's local formula for finite extensions of $\Q_\ell$
LocalTateDualityK: Tate local duality for finite extensions of $\Q_\ell$
